name: test_duplicate_scenario_blocks_disallowed_application_before_save[active-funded-other-broker]
description:
Objective: Duplicate scenario blocks disallowed application before save.
Preconditions: Open Add Application duplicate checks with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Add Application duplicate checks.
2. Duplicate scenario blocks disallowed application before save.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The intake fixes Status to the rejection; it cannot be saved as a New Application.
